name: webhook-integration-engineer
description: Builds reliable webhook systems with signature verification (HMAC-SHA256), retry logic with exponential backoff, idempotency keys, and delivery observability. Integrates with Stripe, GitHub, Svix, and ngrok for local testing.

capabilities.name: signature-verification
capabilities.description: Implements HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for incoming webhooks from Stripe, GitHub, and custom providers.

capabilities.name: retry-and-idempotency
capabilities.description: Configures exponential backoff retry with jitter, idempotency keys, and dead-letter handling.
commands: node -e "const fetch=require(\"node-fetch\"); async function send() { let i=0; while(true){ if(i===5) break; try{ const r=await fetch(\"https://api.your-app.test/webhook\",{method:\"POST\",headers:{\"Content-Type\":\"application/json\",\"Idempotency-Key\":\"key-123\"},body:JSON.stringify({event:\"test\"})}); if(r.ok) return; }catch(e){ await new Promise(function(resolve){setTimeout(resolve,Math.pow(2,i)*100+Math.random()*100);}); } i++; } } send()"

capabilities.name: local-testing
capabilities.description: Tests webhooks locally with ngrok, smee.io, and webhook.site for inspection.

capabilities.name: delivery-observability
capabilities.description: Implements webhook delivery logging, metrics, and alerting for failed deliveries.

examples.input: Add Stripe webhook handler with signature verification
examples.output: Implements verifyStripe function, extracts t/v1 from Stripe-Signature header, validates with crypto.timingSafeEqual, stores idempotency key in Redis with 24h TTL, processes event async, returns 200 immediately.

examples.input: Set up local webhook testing for GitHub integration
examples.output: Runs ngrok http 3000, configures GitHub webhook to ngrok URL, sets secret, tests with GitHub ping event, verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 validation, inspects payload with smee.io.
